rows.label: tlk70000070_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Even in a run-down village like this,
rumors of your exploits reach us.

rows.label: tlk70000070_04_msg0002
rows.name:
All I do now is farm, but I'm still an
adventurer, however rusty. I know the
basics of combat.

rows.label: tlk70000070_04_msg0003
rows.name:
I knew enough to pick up on the
fact that you folks weren't
run-of-the-mill travelers, anyway.

rows.label: tlk70000070_04_msg0004
rows.name:
But it seems people support you for
more than just your strength.

rows.label: tlk70000070_04_msg0005
rows.name:
You're about the only softhearted
people who'd come all this way to meet
someone like me.

rows.label: tlk70000070_04_msg0006
rows.name:
I can't match you, but I'll try hard
enough that my son won't laugh at me.
